sections.title: The command given unto the children of Israel to journey forth in haste.

verses.text: In the plains of Moab, by the Jordan, near the sea of Erithra, by Paran and Tophel, by Laban and Hazeroth, and by Kadesh, Moses spoke to all Israel the words which he commanded them.
The way through the mountains of Seir from Horeb to Kadesh Barnea is an eleven days' journey.
In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that the Lord had commanded him concerning them.
After the defeat of Sihon, the king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and the defeat of Og, the king of Bashan, who dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
In the plains of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying:
"The Lord our God spoke to us at Horeb, saying: 'You have dwelt long enough at this mountain;

Turn and take your journey, and go to the mountains of the Amorites, and to all the neighboring places, in the plain, in the mountains, and in the lowland, and in the south, and by the seacoast, to the land of the Canaanites, and to Lebanon, as far as the great river, the River Euphrates.
Behold, I have set the land before you; go in and possess the land which the Lord swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them and their descendants after them.

sections.title: And Moses appointed the leaders of the people.

verses.text: "In that time, I spoke unto you, saying: I am not able to bear you alone;
Your God, the Lord, hath multiplied you; behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
The God of your fathers, the Lord, add unto you a thousandfold more than ye are, and bless you as He hath spoken unto you.
How can I alone bear your burden, and your strife, and your complaints?
Bring unto me wise men, and understanding men, and known among you; and I will make them rulers over you.
And ye said unto me, 'The thing which thou hast spoken is good.'

I took the wise men, and the known among you, and made them rulers over you, captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, and captains of fifties, and captains of tens, and officers for your tribes.
At that time I commanded your judges, saying: 'Hearken to the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.'

Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God's. And the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.'
And at that time I commanded you all the things which ye should do."

sections.title: And the men who were sent from the wilderness of Paran to spy out the land of Canaan.

verses.text: "And we journeyed from Kadesh; for our God, the Lord, commanded us, saying, 'Go up to the great and terrible land, and there you shall not fear, but traverse the wilderness on all sides, and ascend the mountain of the Amorites; and we came to the gate of the land.'
And I said unto you: 'Our God, the Lord, until He has given you, go up to the mountain of the Amorites.'
Behold, your God, the Lord, is before you, as He has given you the land; the God of your fathers, the Lord, has not forsaken you; go forth; do not fear; do not be dismayed.'

And you all drew near unto me, saying: 'Let us send men before us, that they may search out the land, and bring us word again of the way by which we must go up, and of the cities unto which we shall come.'
And that matter pleased me well; and I took of your men, twelve, one man for each tribe.
And they turned and went up unto the mountain; and they came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, saying: 'Our God, the Lord, hath given us a good land.'
'And you did not refuse to go up; but you rebelled against the command of your God, the Lord.'
And within your tents you murmured, saying: 'The Lord will deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us, because He brought us out of the land of Egypt.'

And where shall we go up? The people is great and numerous; they will surely rise against us; and the cities are great and fortified, reaching even unto heaven; and we saw the sons of the giants there, and our brethren's hearts melted within us."
And I said unto you: Fear not; neither be ye dismayed at them.
For your God, the Lord, who goeth before you, shall fight for you, as He did for you in the land of Egypt, and shall do for you all things concerning you.
And until ye come to this place, in all the way which ye went, your God, the Lord, did not suffer you to be without sustenance, as a man doth not forsake his son in the wilderness.
Yet in this matter, your God, the Lord, ye did not believe.
And He shall choose a place for you, and shall show you the way which is right, by night with fire, and by day with a cloud, as He hath been with you in the way. Yet ye did not believe.

sections.title: The Lord shall lead Israel as a flock.

verses.text: "And the Lord heard the voice of your words and was angry; and He said thus:
To your fathers I will give the good land which none of these men shall see,
except for Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, for he has wholly followed the Lord, and I will give the land which he has walked upon to him and to his children.
And the Lord was angry with me because of you, and He said: 'You also shall not enter there.'
Behold, the son of Nun, Joshua, he shall enter there; encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
Moreover, your little ones, who you said would be prey, and your children who today do not know good from evil, they shall enter there; to them I will give it, and they shall possess it.
But you, turn and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea."

"And you said: 'We have sinned against the Lord; our God is the Lord, and we will go up and fight, as the Lord our God commanded us.' And when you had girded on every man his weapons of war, you went up into the hill country."
And the Lord said: "I am not with you; do not be defeated before your enemies; do not fear them, for I am not with you."
I spoke to you, but you did not listen; you have rejected the word of the Lord, and you went up into the hill country in your own strength."
And there, the Amorites who dwelt in the mountainous land were taken and destroyed; they fell upon you like the bees that swarm, and they were driven away; they were slain from Seir even unto Hermon.
You were also laid low before our God, before the Lord; yet the Lord did not hear your voice, nor did He regard you.
In former times, as you dwelt in the land, you remained for many days in the wilderness of Kadesh.

sections.title: Israel in the years of their sojourn in the wilderness.

verses.text: "And the Lord said, 'Return to the way of the sea, to the wilderness of Edom; you have long encamped by the mountains of Seir.'"
"And the Lord spoke to me, saying:"
"'This mountain shall be your possession; turn back and go toward the land of the Moabites.'"
"And you shall command the people, saying: 'You are to pass through the territory of your brethren, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; they will be afraid of you; therefore, be very careful.'"
"For I have given the mountains of Seir to Esau's descendants as a possession; I have not given you any of their land, not even a footstep, for I have not given it to you."
"You shall buy food from them with money, and you shall eat; and you shall also buy water from them with money, and you shall drink."
"Your God, the Lord, has blessed all the work of your hand; you have known how great and terrible this wilderness is; for forty years the Lord your God has been with you; you have lacked nothing."
"And we passed beyond our brethren, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, along the road of the Arabah, from Elath and Ezion-geber; and we turned and passed through the wilderness of Moab."

"And the Lord said to me: 'Do not harass the Moabites, nor contend with them in battle; for I will not give you any of their land as a possession, because I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as a possession.'"
"As for the Emim, they were a great and numerous people, and tall as the Anakim; they were formerly known as giants, but they dwelt there in their place."
And they were also known as the Rephaim, as it was said; but the Moabites called them "Omin."

The Horites had dwelt in Seir of old; but the children of Esau had slain them, and destroyed them from before them; and the Lord had given their land to Israel as He had done, and they dwelt in their stead.
Now rise up and go forth; flee from the fear of today; we have fled from the fear of today.

And until we fled from the fear of today, the Lord, as it was said concerning them, made them as fighters of that generation, from among those who dwelt there, until they were destroyed, a period of thirty-eight years.
And from among those who dwelt there, until they were destroyed, the hand of the Lord was upon them.
"Thus it was; the fighters were destroyed, and among the people, after death,
the Lord spoke to me, saying:
'You today shall pass by the border of Moab, even Ar,

and because I have given a heritage to the children of Lot, I shall not give you the land of the children of Ammon as a heritage; and when you come near the children of Ammon, do not distress them; do not provoke them.'
And likewise, the land of the Rephaim was called; for the Rephaim had dwelt there of old; but the Ammonites called them "Zamzummim."
እነርሱም እንደ ዔናቃውያን ታላቅና ብዙ፥ ጽኑዓንም ሕዝብ ነበሩ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከፊታቸው አጠፋቸው፤ እነርሱንም አሳድደው በስፍራቸው ተቀመጡ።
ሖራውያንን ከፊታቸው አጥፍቶ በሴይር ለተቀመጡት ለዔሳው ልጆች እንዳደረገ እነርሱ ወረሱአቸው፤ በእነርሱም ፋንታ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ተቀመጡ።
እስከ ጋዛም ድረስ በአሴሮት ተቀምጠው የነበሩትን ኤዋውያንንና ከቀጰዶቅያ የወጡ ቀጰዶቃውያንን አጠፉአቸው፤ በእነርሱም ፋንታ ተቀመጡ።
ደግሞም አለ፦ ተነሥታችሁ ሂዱ፤ የአርኖንንም ሸለቆ ተሻገሩ፤ እነሆ፥ አሞሬዎናዊውን የሐሴቦንን ንጉሥ ሴዎንን፥ ምድሩንም በእጅህ አሳልፌ ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ እርስዋን ግዛት፤ ውረሳት፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ተዋጋ።
ከሰማይ በታች ባሉ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ ማስደንገጥህንና ማስፈራትህን እሰድድ ዘንድ ዛሬ እጀምራለሁ፤ ስምህን በሰሙ ጊዜ በፊትህ ይንቀጠቀጣሉ፤ ድንጋጤም ይይዛቸዋል።

sections.title: And Israel smote King Sihon as he had done. (Numbers 21:21-30)

verses.text: “ከቄድሞትም ምድረ በዳ የሰላምን ቃል ይነግሩት ዘንድ ወደ ሐሴቦን ንጉሥ ወደ ሴዎን እንዲህ ብዬ መልእክተኞችን ላክሁ፦
‘በሀገርህ ላይ ልለፍ፤ በአውራ ጎዳና እሄዳለሁ፤ ወደ ቀኝም ወደ ግራም አልተላለፍም።
የምበላውን ምግብ በገንዘብ ሽጥልኝ፤ የምጠጣውንም ውኃ በገንዘብ ስጠኝ፤ በእግሬ ብቻ ልለፍ፤
በሴይር የተቀመጡ የዔሳው ልጆች፥ በአሮዔርም የተቀመጡ ሞዓባውያን እንዳደረጉልኝ፥ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ወደሚሰጠን ምድር ዮርዳኖስን እስክሻገር ድረስ በእግሬ ልለፍ።
የሐሴቦን ንጉሥ ሴዎን ግን ያሳልፈን ዘንድ አልፈቀደም፤ እንደ ዛሬው ሁሉ በእጅህ አሳልፎ ይሰጠው ዘንድ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር መንፈሱን አደንድኖታልና፥ ልቡንም አጽንቶታልና።
እግዚአብሔርም፦ ‘የሐሴቦንን ንጉሥ አሞራዊውን ሴዎንንና ምድሩን በፊትህ በእጅህ አሳልፌ መስጠት እነሆ፥ ጀመርሁ፤ ምድሩን ትገዛ ዘንድ መውረስ ጀምር’ አለኝ።
ሴዎንም ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ሊዋጉን ወደ ኢያሳ ወጡ።
አምላካችንም እግዚአብሔር እርሱን አሳልፎ በእጃችን ሰጠን፤ እርሱንም፥ ልጆቹንም፥ ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ መታን።
በዚያን ጊዜም ከተሞቹን ሁሉ ወሰድን፤ ከተማውንም ሁሉ፥ ሴቶችንም፥ ሕፃኖችንም አጠፋን፤ አንዳችም የሸሸ በሕይወት አላስቀረንም፥
ለእኛ ከማረክናቸው ከብቶቻቸውና ከከተሞቻቸው ከወሰድነው ምርኮ በቀር።

From the region of Arnon, which is by the river, from Aroer and within the city that is by the river, we began to journey as far as the mountain of Gilead; yet we did not encroach upon any city. Our God, the Lord, delivered all into our hands.
But the Lord our God did not allow us to approach the land of the children of Ammon, nor to the place of Jabbok, nor to any of the cities of the mountainous region.

sections.title: The children of Israel smote Og, the king of Bashan, as they had done unto him.

verses.text: "We returned and went out by the way of Bashan; the king of Bashan was Og, and all his people went out to fight against us in Edrei."

"And the Lord said unto me: 'Fear not him, for I have delivered him and all his people into thy hand, and the land also, which I have given into thy hand; as I did unto Sihon king of the Amorites, so shall I do unto him.'"
"Our God, the Lord, also delivered into our hands the king of Bashan, Og, and all his people; and we utterly destroyed them, so that not one remained of them."
"At that time we took all the cities of those people; there was not a city which we took not from them; we took the kingdom of Og, which was in Bashan, all the region of Argob, and sixty cities."
"Indeed, there were many cities besides the cities of the Amorites; all these cities were fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, and were very great."
"And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon; every city, and all the women and children, we utterly destroyed."
"We took all the livestock of those cities, and the spoil of the cities we brought unto ourselves."
"In that time we took the land from the river Arnon unto Mount Hermon; all the region that was inhabited by the two kings of the Amorites we took."
"The Sidonians call Hermon 'Sirion,' and the Amorites call it 'Senir.'"
"All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, which was called the kingdom of Og, we took, even unto Elked and unto Edrei."

And there remained only Og, the king of Bashan, of the remnant of the giants; behold, his bed was a bed of iron. Is it not in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.

sections.title: The cities that dwelt beyond the Jordan on the east side.

verses.text: "This land, which you shall inherit in that time, from the Arnon ravine to the border of the land of Gilead, shall be yours; and the cities shall be given to Reuben and Gad."
"And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, which was called the land of giants, I have given to the half-tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, is called a land of giants."
"The son of Manasseh, Jair, took all the region of Argob as far as Gergesh and Maachah; this is the land of Bashan, which is called after his name, until this day."
"To Machir, I gave Gilead."
"And to Reuben and Gad, I gave the land of Gilead, from the Arnon ravine to the border of the ravine, and to the border of the children of Ammon, as far as the river Jabbok."
"From the wilderness and this Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, I have given to you."

"In that time, I commanded you, saying: 'The Lord your God has given you this land to possess it; you shall pass over armed before your brethren, the children of Israel, all you mighty men of valor.'"
"But I know that you have very great and strong hearts, and your wives and your children shall dwell in the cities which I have given you."

"For the Lord your God, as He has done to you, will continue to do to your brethren until they possess the land which the Lord your God is giving them; and afterward you shall return, every man to his possession which I have given you."
"At that time, I commanded Joshua, saying: 'Your eyes have seen all that the Lord your God has done to these two kings; so shall the Lord do to all the kingdoms where you go.'"
The Lord your God, He shall fight for you; therefore, do not be afraid of them.

sections.title: And Moses was warned that he should not enter the land of promise.

verses.text: "In that time, I shall call upon the Lord God, saying thus:

O Lord God! Thou hast begun to show me Thy greatness and Thy power, and the mighty hand that is stretched out, and Thy strong arm; for who is a God that can do according to Thy works, and according to Thy might, in heaven and on earth?
That I may dwell, and that the good land which is beyond the Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon, may not be given to me as a possession.
But the Lord was angry with me for your sakes, and He did not hearken unto me; and the Lord said unto me: 'It is enough for thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.'

Thou shalt not go over this Jordan, but go thou up to the top of the mountain, and lift up thine eyes toward the sea and toward the west, and toward the south, and toward the east, and behold it with thine eyes.
For He shall go before this people, and thou shalt see the land which He shall give unto them; therefore, encourage him and strengthen him.
Let us sit down face to face before the tabernacle."

sections.title: A counsel given for the people of Israel to become a new creation.

verses.text: "Now therefore, O Israel, heed to do them, that you may live and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers is giving you. Today, hear the statutes and judgments which I teach you."
"Today I command you to keep the commandments of the LORD your God; you shall not add to the word which I command you, nor take from it."
"Every person who follows Baal-Peor, your God, the LORD has separated from you and has perished; your God, the LORD, has not opened your eyes to see what He has done to Baal-Peor."
"But you, who have followed the LORD your God, are alive, every one of you, to this day."
"Behold, you are entering the land that you shall inherit; thus the LORD your God has commanded me to show you statutes and judgments."

"Keep them; do them; hear all these statutes: Behold, 'This great nation is a wise and understanding people,' for what nation is there so great that has statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law which I set before you this day?"
"Our God, the LORD, at all times when we call upon Him, who is this great nation that has been brought near to Him?"
"Today, before you, what great nation is there that has such righteous statutes and judgments as this law which I set before you this day?"
"Know for yourself; keep your body; do not forget all that your eyes have seen; let it not depart from your heart all the days of your life; teach them to your children and your children's children."

"The LORD gathered the people to me; they may learn to fear Me all the days that they live upon the earth, and teach their children to do so, that they may hear My words, and when you are gathered together, speak of them before your Creator, the LORD."
And ye stood at the foot of the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the heavens; there was darkness, and a tempestuous wind, and thick darkness was there.
And the Lord spake unto you out of the midst of the fire; ye heard the voice of words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.
And ye shall do according to the words which I command you this day; and ye shall write them upon two stone tablets.
That ye may possess the land whither ye go to possess it, and that ye may learn to do all the statutes and judgments which the Lord your God shall teach you; and in that day the Lord commanded me.

sections.title: A warning given concerning the abominations of idolatry.

verses.text: "The Lord your God spoke to you out of the midst of the fire at Horeb; you heard the sound of words, but saw no form; you only heard a voice. Therefore, take heed to yourselves, and guard your souls diligently."
"Lest you act corruptly, and make for yourselves a carved image, the likeness of any figure, the likeness of male or female, of any animal that is on the earth,"
"the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the air,"
"the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, and the likeness of any fish that is in the water beneath the earth."

"And beware, lest you raise your eyes to heaven, and when you see the sun, the moon, and the stars, all the host of heaven, you be drawn away and worship them and serve them, which the Lord your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole heaven."
"But you, as you are this day, are the people of the Lord your God, whom the Lord has taken and brought out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace."
"The Lord was angry with you because of your words, and He swore that you would not cross over the Jordan, nor enter the good land which the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance."
"But I, I will die in this land; I will not cross over the Jordan; but you shall cross over and possess that good land."

"Take heed to yourselves, lest you forget the covenant of the Lord your God, which He made with you, and make for yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which the Lord your God has forbidden you."
"For the Lord your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God."

"Children, and the children of your children, at the time of your birth, when you dwell long in the land, at the time of your prosperity, and when you make any image that is graven, do not forget that in the sight of your God, the Lord, it is an evil thing that you have done."

"That you may perish, I today call heaven and earth to witness against you, that you may quickly perish from the land which you go to possess; you shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed."
"And the Lord shall scatter you among the nations; and the Lord shall leave you few in number among the nations where He shall lead you."
"And there you shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell."
"But if from there you seek the Lord your God, you will find Him, if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul."
"And when you are in tribulation, and all these things come upon you in the latter days, if you turn to the Lord your God and obey His voice."
"For the Lord your God is a merciful God; He will not forsake you, nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which He swore to them."
"For the Lord God created man in the beginning, and formed him from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living being."
"And you shall hear the voice of the living God speaking in the midst of the fire, as you are alive, and you shall be as another people hearing."

"Our God, the Lord, has shown you all these things before your eyes in Egypt, as He did all His wonders and signs, and with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, He brought you out from among the nations."
The Lord your God is indeed God, and there is no other god besides Him, that you may know this.
He shall teach you, and from heaven He shall make His voice heard; and on the earth, He shall show you the great fire; and from the midst of the fire, you shall hear His word.
He loved your fathers and chose their descendants after them; and with you, He brought them out of Egypt with great power.
Today, as it has been, may He cast out before you the great nations that are stronger than you, and may He bring you in, and may He give you their land as an inheritance.
Therefore, know today that the Lord is God in heaven above and on the earth below; there is no other. Let this be in your heart.

For you, and after you for your children, may it be well with you, that your God, the Lord, may prolong your days upon the land which He gives you forever; and I command you today to keep His statutes and His commandments.

sections.title: Cities of refuge for the slayers of the soul.

verses.text: And in that time, Moses designated three cities in the region east of the Jordan, in the land of Moab.
Yesterday, lest the avenger of blood pursue the slayer, who is not deserving of death, and he be unaware, that he may flee to one of these cities and live;
For Reuben, there was a territory in the wilderness, in the land of Dibon; for Gad, a territory in Gilead; and for Manasseh, a territory in Bashan, which was called Golan.

sections.title: An Explanation Concerning His Law

verses.text: ሙሴም በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ያኖራት ሕግ ይህች ናት፤
ከግብፅ በወጡ ጊዜ ሙሴ ለእስራኤል ልጆች የተናገረው ምስክርና ሥርዐት፤ ፍርድም ይህ ነው።
ሙሴና የእስራኤል ልጆች ከግብፅ ከወጡ በኋላ በመቱት፥ በሐሴቦን ተቀምጦ በነበረው በአሞሬዎን ንጉሥ በሴዎን ምድር፥ በቤተ ፌጎር አቅራቢያ ባለው ሸለቆ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ፤
የእርሱንና የባሳንን ንጉሥ፥ የዐግን ምድር፥ በምሥራቅ በኩል በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ የነበሩትን የሁለቱን የአሞሬዎንን ነገሥታት ምድር ወሰዱ።
በአርኖን ወንዝ ዳር ካለችው ከአሮዔር ጀምሮ እስከ ሴዎን ተራራ እስከ ኤርሞን ድረስ፥
በምሥራቅም በኩል በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ መሿለኪያ ካለው ከአሴዶን ተራራ በታች ያለውን ዓረባ ሁሉ ወሰዱ።

sections.title: The Ten Commandments

verses.text: And Moses called all Israel and said unto them, “Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.”
The Lord your God made a covenant with you in Horeb.
The Lord did not make this covenant with your fathers, but with you, even with you, all of you who are alive this day.
The Lord spake unto you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire.
I stood between the Lord and you at that time, to show you the word of the Lord: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount; and he said,
“I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.”
“Thou shalt have no other gods before me.”

“Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or in the earth beneath, or in the water under the earth; thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them.”
“Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain; for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.”

“For I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me; and showing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.”
"Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain; for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh His name in vain."
"Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy; as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee."
"Six days shalt thou labor, and do all thy work;"

"But the seventh day is the Sabbath of the Lord thy God; in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy ox, nor thy ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou."

"Remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the Lord thy God brought thee out thence with a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm; therefore the Lord thy God commanded thee to keep the Sabbath day."
"Honor thy father and thy mother, as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be long, and that it may go well with thee in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee."
"Thou shalt not kill."
"Thou shalt not commit adultery."
"Thou shalt not steal."
"Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbor; neither shalt thou desire any false testimony."
"Thou shalt not covet thy neighbor's wife; thou shalt not covet thy neighbor's house, his field, nor his servant, nor his maid, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbor's."

"The Lord spoke unto you out of the midst of the fire; ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice. And He declared unto you His covenant, which He commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and He wrote them upon two tables of stone."

sections.title: Concerning the fear of the people.

verses.text: "Thus it came to pass; when the voice was heard among you in the midst of the fire, and the mountain trembled with fire, you, your leaders, your elders, drew near unto me;
"And you said: Behold, our God, the Lord, has shown us His glory and His greatness; we have heard His voice out of the midst of the fire; and the Lord spoke with man, yet man did not live today."
"Now do not be afraid; for this great fire will not consume you; if we hear again the voice of our God, the Lord, we shall surely die."
"For who is there of all flesh that has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?"
"Draw near; hear all that our God, the Lord, shall say; and all that our God, the Lord, shall speak unto you, let us hear it, and we will do it."
"When you spoke unto me, the Lord heard the voice of your words; and the Lord said unto me: I have heard the voice of this people, which they have spoken unto you; all that they have spoken is good."
"For them, and for their children forever, may it be well with them, that they may fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it may be well with them."
"Go, return unto your tents."

"But you, stand here by me, that I may declare unto you all the commandments and the statutes and the judgments which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess."
"And the Lord your God commanded you to observe these things, that you may keep them; and do not turn to the right hand or to the left."

"That you may live and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess, the Lord your God shall guide you in all the ways which He has commanded you."

sections.title: The Great Commandment

verses.text: "That you may observe the commandments and statutes which the Lord your God has commanded you, as you enter the land which you are to possess, this is the judgment."

"You, and your children, and your children's children, shall fear the Lord your God all the days of your life, to keep all His statutes and His commandments which I command you, that your days may be prolonged."

"Hear, O Israel: The land which the Lord your God is giving you to possess, is a land flowing with milk and honey, as the Lord God of your fathers has spoken, that you may greatly increase, and that it may be well with you. This is the law and judgment which Moses commanded the children of Israel after they came out of the land of Egypt."
"Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one."
"You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might."
"And today I command you to lay these words upon your heart and upon your soul."
"And you shall teach them to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up."
"And you shall bind them as a sign upon your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes."
"And you shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates."

sections.title: A warning given concerning the unheeded.

verses.text: "The Lord your God will give you, as He promised to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, a land flowing with milk and honey, when you enter it."
"And houses filled with all good things, which you did not fill, and wells dug, which you did not dig, and vineyards and olive groves, which you did not plant, when you eat and are full."
"Beware that you do not forget the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage."
"You shall fear the Lord your God; Him you shall serve, and by His name you shall swear."
"You shall not go after other gods, the gods of the peoples who are around you."
"For the Lord your God is a jealous God among you, lest the anger of the Lord your God be aroused against you and destroy you from the face of the earth."
"You shall not tempt the Lord your God, as you tempted Him in Massah."
"You shall diligently keep the commandments of the Lord your God, His testimonies, and His statutes which He has commanded you."
"And it shall be well with you, and you may go in and possess the good land which the Lord swore to your fathers, to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey."
"The Lord will destroy all the nations before you, and you shall dispossess greater and mightier nations than yourselves."
"But your son: Our God, the Lord, has commanded you a witness and a law; what is judgment? When you are asked, say this."
"You shall say to your son: We were servants of Pharaoh in Egypt; but the Lord brought us out with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm He delivered us."
"And the Lord set great and terrible signs in Egypt and upon Pharaoh and all his house before our eyes."
"To bring us into the land which He swore to our fathers, and to give it to us, He brought us out from there."
"As today, that we may live, and always that it may be well with us, to fear our God, the Lord, and that we may do all these statutes which the Lord has commanded us."
"And as He has commanded us, we shall do before our God, the Lord; and if we keep all these commandments, it shall be mercy for us."

sections.title: Concerning the separation from the nations.

verses.text: "When the Lord your God brings you into the land which you are entering to possess, and drives out before you many nations, the great nations and mightier than you, the Hittites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than you,"
"The Lord your God will deliver them over to you, and you shall conquer them and utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them."
"You shall not intermarry with them; you shall not give your daughter to their son, nor take their daughter for your son."
"For they will turn your sons away from following Me, to serve other gods. Then the anger of the Lord will be aroused against you and destroy you suddenly."
"But thus you shall deal with them: you shall destroy their altars, and break down their sacred pillars, and cut down their wooden images, and burn their carved images with fire."
"For you are a holy people to the Lord your God; the Lord your God has chosen you to be a people for Himself, a special treasure above all the peoples on the face of the earth."
"The Lord did not set His love on you nor choose you because you were more in number than any other people, for you were the least of all peoples;"

"But because the Lord loves you, and because He would keep the oath which He swore to your fathers, the Lord has brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you from the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt."
"Therefore you shall know that the Lord your God, He is God, the faithful God who keeps covenant and mercy for a thousand generations with those who love Him and keep His commandments."
"He repays those who hate Him to their face, to destroy them; He will not be slack with him who hates Him; He will repay him to his face."
Therefore, I command you today to observe the statutes and ordinances that I set before you, and to keep justice.

sections.title: For the Lord, obedience is a blessing that is bestowed.

verses.text: "Thus shall it be; if you heed this judgment and keep it, and if you perform it, your God, the Lord, shall keep for you the covenant and mercy which He swore to your fathers."

"He shall love you; He shall bless you; He shall multiply you; He shall give you the fruit of your womb, and the fruit of your land, your grain, your wine, your oil, the increase of your cattle, and the young of your flock shall be blessed."
"You shall be more blessed than all peoples; there shall not be a male or female barren among you, nor among your livestock."

"When He comes upon the Egyptians, He shall remove from you all sickness and all the evil diseases of Egypt, which you have seen; and He shall not allow them to come upon you, but He shall lay them upon all who hate you."
"Your God, the Lord, shall remove from you all the diseases of the nations; your eyes shall not see them; for they shall be a curse upon you, and you shall not call upon their gods."
"In your heart, you may say: 'These nations are greater than I; how can I dispossess them?' You shall not be afraid of them."
"But you shall remember what the Lord your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt."

"Your God, the Lord, shall set His eyes upon you; He shall perform great wonders, signs, and miracles, and He shall stretch out His hand and mighty arm to deliver you; thus shall your God, the Lord, do to all the nations before whom you are afraid."
"Moreover, your God, the Lord, shall send the remnant that remain before you until they are destroyed; He shall send them before you as a sign."
"You shall not be terrified before them; for your God, the Lord, is with you; He is your God, the Lord, great and mighty."

Your God, the Lord, shall destroy these nations before you, little by little; lest the land become desolate and the beasts of the field multiply against you; I shall quickly destroy them, do not fear.
But your God, the Lord, shall deliver them into your hand, and until they are destroyed, He shall cause them to be greatly dismayed before you.
Their kings also shall He deliver into your hand; and their name shall He blot out from under heaven; and no man shall be able to stand before you until you have destroyed them.

You shall burn their graven images with fire; and you shall not covet the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto yourself, lest you be ensnared therein; for it is an abomination unto the Lord your God.
You shall not bring an abominable thing into your house, lest you become a cursed thing like it; but you shall utterly detest it, and you shall utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.

sections.title: A guide given for the inheritance of the land of the hopeful.

verses.text: "That you may live and multiply, and that the Lord your God may bring you into the land which He swore to your fathers, to give it to you, today you shall keep all the commandments that I command you."

"May your God, the Lord, test you, and may you keep the commandments that are in your heart, whether you keep them or not, that you may know, and may He consider all the ways in which you have walked in the wilderness."

"For man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds from the mouth of God, lest you be reminded that man does not live by bread alone, and you may be troubled, and you shall not forget what your fathers did not know."
"I have not put on the garment of mourning; nor have I walked barefoot; behold, I have been forty years."
"As a man raises his son, so may your God, the Lord, raise you up in your heart."
"As you go on your way, fear Him, and keep the commandments of your God, the Lord."
"Your God, the Lord, shall bring you to a good and spacious land, a land flowing with streams and springs of water, and where there are valleys and hills."
"Wheat, barley, and wine, and oil, and honey, and all the good things of the land shall be yours."
"Without hindrance, you shall eat the bread of the land, and nothing shall be lacking in the land, whether it be stone or iron, and from its mountains you shall dig copper."
"You shall eat and be satisfied; you shall drink and be filled; and for the good land which He has given you, you shall give thanks to your God, the Lord."

sections.title: A warning given that they may not forsake the Lord God.

verses.text: "Today I command you to take heed to observe the commandments and the judgments, and to keep the statutes, lest you forget the Lord your God, the Lord of hosts; be vigilant."
"After you have eaten and are satisfied, then you shall build a good house and dwell therein."
"When your herds and flocks multiply, and your silver and gold are multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied, let not your heart be lifted up."
"He who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage."
"The serpent that bites and the scorpion, and the darkness that has no water, in the great and terrible wilderness where you have been led, from the rock that brings forth water."
"In the end, may He do good for you, that He may test you, and may your fathers not forget the manna that He fed you in the wilderness, lest you forget the Lord your God."
"In your heart: 'By my strength, by the might of my hand, I have done all this,' do not say."
"But today, as it is said to your fathers, remember the covenant, for He gives you strength; consider your God, the Lord of hosts."
"If you utterly forget the Lord your God, and follow other gods, and serve them, and bow down to them, I declare to you today that I will testify against you in heaven and earth."
"Because you have not listened to the word of your God, the Lord will destroy you from before Him, as He will destroy all nations; so shall you also perish."

sections.title: The offering that is made unto the Lord shall be a sweet savor.

verses.text: "O Israel, hear; you shall enter the land which the Lord your God is giving you, and you shall drive out the nations before you, greater and mightier than you, whose cities are great and fortified up to heaven, even today you shall cross the Jordan."
"And you know, concerning them: who can stand before the children of Enoch? When it is said, you have heard, they are a great and numerous people, the children of Enoch."

"Your God, the Lord, will pass before you today; He is a consuming fire; He will destroy them, and He will subdue them before you; and the Lord will drive them out from before you, as He has spoken to you, He will hasten to destroy them."

"When your God, the Lord, drives out those nations from before you, do not say in your heart, 'Because of my righteousness the Lord has brought me in to possess this good land'; but it is because of the wickedness of these nations that the Lord is driving them out before you."

"You shall not inherit their land because of your righteousness and the uprightness of your heart; but the Lord your God is driving them out before you because of their wickedness, and to fulfill the word which He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob."
"Therefore, you are a chosen people, and the Lord your God has given you this good land as an inheritance; know today that it is not because of your righteousness that you possess it."
"Consider how the Lord your God has dealt with you in the wilderness, from the day you departed from the land of Egypt until you came to this place; do not forget."
"At Horeb, you also provoked the Lord to wrath; and the Lord was angry with you to destroy you."

"The two stone tablets, which the Lord gave you, the covenant tablets, I received when I went up the mountain; and I remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights; I neither ate bread nor drank water."
"And the Lord gave me the two tablets of stone, written with the finger of God; and all the words which the Lord spoke to you were written on those tablets."
And after forty days and forty nights, the Lord gave me the two tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant.

And the Lord said unto me: "Arise, go down quickly from here; for your people, whom you brought out of Egypt, have corrupted themselves; they have quickly turned aside from the way which I commanded them; they have made themselves a molten image."
And the Lord said unto me: "Once, even twice, I have spoken to you; this people has become stiff-necked, and I cannot bear them as a people."
To destroy them, I will cause their name to be blotted out from under heaven; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they."
And I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain burned with fire; and the two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.
Behold, before your God, the Lord, as you have sinned, you have made a molten image to keep you from the way which the Lord commanded you; when I saw it, I was grieved.
Take hold of the two tablets; and I took them from my hands, and I broke them before your eyes.

Concerning all the sins you have committed, to provoke Him to anger, I have done evil in the sight of the Lord; and for forty days and forty nights I remained there, neither eating bread nor drinking water.
And the Lord was angry with you to destroy you, and I feared the anger and hot displeasure wherewith the Lord was angry against you; and the Lord hearkened unto me at that time also.
And the Lord was very angry with Aaron to destroy him; and I prayed for Aaron at that time also.

Concerning your sins, I have taken the image of the slaughtered one; and I have burned it with fire; I have consumed it; until it became as a heap, I have made it a heap; and I have cast it into the river that descends from the mountain.
"In the wilderness, in the trial, and in the grave of desire, you have provoked the Lord your God."

And the Lord said: "Go forth; the land which I have given you shall be desolate; when I sent you forth from the holy place, at the time of your God, you have despised the word of your God; and you have not believed in Him; nor have you heard His word."
From the day you were known to Him, you have been in the Lord's desolation.
"And the Lord said: 'Because you have been destroyed, as it was spoken before, I have been as a man for forty days and forty nights before the Lord.'"

And before the Lord I prayed, saying: "O Lord God of the angelic king, in Your great power, do not destroy Your people and Your inheritance, which You brought out of Egypt by Your mighty hand and Your outstretched arm."
Remember Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, Your servants; do not regard this people’s stubbornness, their wickedness, and their sin.

Those who brought us out of the land of Egypt, O Lord, we are unable to enter the land which You have given them; for they have cried out against us, and therefore let them not say that they have led us into the wilderness to destroy us."
And they are Your people and Your inheritance, whom You have brought out of the land of Egypt by Your great power, and by Your outstretched arm.

sections.title: Moses received the Ten Commandments anew.

verses.text: "At that time, the Lord said, 'As for you, carve for yourself two tablets of stone like the first ones, and come up to Me on the mountain; and you shall make for yourself an ark of wood.'
"In their breaking, I shall write all the words that were on the first tablets upon these tablets; and you shall put them in the ark."
"I made the ark of acacia wood; and like the first tablets, I carved two stone tablets; and I went up the mountain; and the two tablets were in my hand."
"And the Lord spoke to you out of the fire on the mountain, and He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, which He commanded me to give to you; and the Lord gave them to me."
"Then I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and the Lord commanded me, and there they are."
"And the children of Israel journeyed from the wells of Benejaakan to Moseroth; and there Aaron died and was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered as priest in his stead."
"From there they journeyed to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to the land of rivers of water, to the region of Etebatha."

"At that time, the ark of the covenant of the Lord shall be carried, that it may stand before the Lord to minister to Him, and in His name it shall be blessed until this day, for the Levites have no inheritance."
"Therefore, the Levites have no portion or inheritance with their brethren; the Lord your God is their inheritance, as He said to them."
"And I stood on the mountain as I did the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the Lord listened to me at that time also; and the Lord was not willing to destroy you."
And the Lord said, "Arise, go forth before the people; and to their fathers I shall give them, and let them dwell in the land of their inheritance; and they shall be delivered."

sections.title: To fear the Lord God, whom Israel seeks, is indeed the essence of reverence.

verses.text: "O Israel, what doth the Lord thy God require of thee, but to fear the Lord thy God, to walk in all His ways, and to love Him, and to serve the Lord thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul?"
"Today, it is for thee to keep the commandments and statutes of the Lord thy God, that it may be well with thee."
"Behold, the heavens, and the heaven of heavens, the earth, and all that is therein, belong unto the Lord thy God."
"The Lord did choose thee to be a special people unto Himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth."
"You shall circumcise the foreskin of your heart; and you shall not be stiff-necked any more."
"The Lord your God is a great God, a mighty and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward."
"He doth execute judgment for the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment."
"And you shall love the stranger, for you were strangers in the land of Egypt."
"Thou shalt fear the Lord thy God; Him shalt thou serve, and to Him shalt thou cleave, and swear by His name."
"The great things which thine eyes have seen, the signs and the wonders, are a testimony unto thee; for He is thy God."
Your forefathers went down to Egypt, being seventy souls; and now the Lord your God hath made you as the stars of heaven for multitude.

sections.title: The benefit of obedience.

verses.text: "Thou shalt love the Lord thy God, and keep His commandments, His statutes, His judgments, and His testimonies all the days of thy life."
"Today, let your children know the works of your God, the greatness of the Lord, His mighty hand, and His outstretched arm, that they may see and know and not forget."
"In the midst of Egypt, concerning the wonders and great works that He performed upon Pharaoh and all his land,"
"As you followed Him, even in the time when He brought forth water from the sea in Eritrea, the Lord has preserved you until this day, as He did in Egypt with their horses and chariots."
"Until you come to this place, all that He has done for you in the wilderness,"
"In all of Israel, the land swallowed them up, and their houses, their tents, and all that was theirs, as He did to them by the hand of Reuben's son, by the sons of Eliab, by Dathan and Abiram."
"The great works which the Lord has done for you, your eyes have not seen."

sections.title: The land of the hopeful is blessed.

verses.text: "As you dwell in life, and as you multiply, and as you inherit the land which you are to possess, the land of Jordan, today keep all the commandments that I am giving you."

"The Lord your God shall give to them and to their descendants after them the land which flows with milk and honey, that your days may be prolonged upon the land which the Lord swore to your fathers."
"You shall inherit the land which you are to enter, a land where you shall sow your seed as a garden, and you shall drink from the water of your foot."
"But you shall inherit the land which you are to possess, a land of hills and valleys, a country where the rain of heaven is poured out."
"Your God, the Lord, is a land which the Lord cares for; from the beginning of the year to the end of the year, the eyes of the Lord your God are always upon it."
"You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and you shall keep His commandments today."
"He shall give you the rain of your land in its season, the former rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain, and your wine, and your oil."
"He shall give grass in your fields for your cattle, that you may eat and be full."
"Let not your heart be deceived, and do not turn aside to serve other gods, and do not bow down to them."

"And let not the anger of the Lord be kindled against you, and let not the heavens withhold their rain, and let not the land yield its fruit; and lest you perish quickly from off the good land which the Lord is giving you."
"Therefore, you shall bind these words upon your hearts and upon your souls; and you shall bind them for a sign upon your hands, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes."
"And you shall teach them to your children, speaking of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up."
"And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gates."
"That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the LORD swore unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth."
"You shall love the LORD your God, and walk in all His ways, and keep His commandments, and His statutes, and His judgments, and you shall obey His voice."
"The LORD shall cause all these nations to be driven out from before you; and you shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves."

"Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours; from the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun shall be your coast."
"There shall not any man be able to stand before you; for the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that you shall tread upon, as He hath said unto you."
"Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse."
"A blessing, if you obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you this day."

If you do not heed the command of your God, the Lord, today if you say, "Let us turn aside from the way," and if you follow other gods that you do not know, it is indeed a matter of your own choosing.

The Lord your God shall grant you an inheritance in the land to which you go, and when you enter, you shall dwell upon the blessed heights of the mountains, and your dwelling shall be upon the exalted hills.
And they are by the Jordan, in the valley, at the entrance of the sun, behind the way that leads to the wilderness, in the land of the Canaanites, they are before the great tree, side by side.
Your God, the Lord, shall give you a land that you may dwell in forever, and you shall possess it, and you shall inherit the Jordan; you shall inherit it, and you shall dwell therein.
And I too, today, before you, shall command all the statutes and judgments that you shall keep. Therefore, take heed.

sections.title: A place that is fitting for the offering to be made.

verses.text: "In all the days of your dwelling upon the earth, the Lord your God, the God of your fathers, shall be revered; and in the land which He shall give you, you shall observe the statutes and judgments, for this is the commandment."

"You shall utterly destroy the nations which you shall dispossess, and all their graven images, and every high place; you shall break down their altars, and you shall burn their graven images with fire; and you shall utterly destroy the name of those places."
"And you shall break down their altars, and you shall shatter their pillars, and you shall burn their graven images with fire; and you shall utterly destroy the name of those places."
"You shall not do so unto the Lord your God."
"But the Lord your God shall choose one place out of all your tribes to put His name there; and there shall you go."

"And there you shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and the offerings of your hand, and your vow offerings, and your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herds and of your flocks."
"And there you shall eat before the Lord your God, and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand unto, you and your households, in which the Lord your God hath blessed you."
"Every man shall see what is good and right in his own eyes; but you shall not do all that we are doing here this day."
"The Lord your God hath not given you rest and inheritance as of yet, even unto this day."

"But when you cross over the Jordan, and dwell in the land which the Lord your God is giving you to inherit, and when He gives you rest from all your enemies round about, so that you dwell in safety,"

At that time, your God, the Lord, shall be called upon by His name, and to that chosen place, I command you all your offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, and all the first fruits of your hand's work, which you have chosen, bring them all to your God.
And you, your sons and your daughters, and your male and female servants, since there is no portion or inheritance with you, shall rejoice in the presence of your God, the Lord.
Take heed that you do not offer your sacrifices in every place that you see.
However, your God, the Lord, shall be the one to choose a place from among your tribes, and there you shall offer your sacrifices; and there today, I command you all that I have commanded you.
"But your God, the Lord, as He has given you blessings, as He has commanded you, shall cause you to eat flesh in all your land; let the clean man eat, and let the unclean man eat as he may."
But you shall not eat the blood; you shall pour it out on the ground like water.

You shall not be able to eat the tithes of your grain, your wine, your oil, the firstborn of your herd and your flock, nor any of your offerings that you vow, nor any of your freewill offerings, nor the firstborn of your herds and flocks, in your cities.

However, you, your son and your daughter, your male and female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates, shall rejoice before your God, the Lord, in the place which the Lord your God shall choose; and in all that you set your hand to do, may you rejoice before your God.
Take heed that you do not forsake the Levite as long as you live in your land.

"Your God, the Lord, as He has spoken to you, at the time when He enlarges your borders, and your body shall eat flesh because you desire to eat; when you say, 'I will eat flesh,' you may eat as much as you desire."

Your God, the Lord, shall be called by that name; even if the chosen place be far from you, the Lord shall command you to bring your offerings, whether of lamb or goat; and your body shall consume that which you have desired within your land.
As the clean and pure shall be consumed, so shall it be; let the one who is pure eat, and let the one who is not pure partake.
Take heed that you do not consume blood; for the blood is the life thereof, and the soul shall not be eaten with the flesh.
On the earth, do not consume it as water is poured out.
When you do good and right in the sight of your God, that it may be well with you, and that it may be well with your children after you, do not consume.
However, concerning that which is holy to you, and your offerings, let your God, the Lord, be called by that name; go to the chosen place.
Prepare a sacrifice that is to be offered, and bring it to your God, the Lord, at the altar; and let the blood of your sacrifice be poured out upon the altar of your God; consume the flesh.
When you do good and right in the sight of your God, that it may be well with you and with your children forever, keep all these words which I command you.

sections.title: To offer sacrifice to idols is not fitting.

verses.text: "Thou shalt not follow after the gods of those nations which thou shalt dispossess before thee; neither shalt thou serve their gods; for it shall be a snare unto thee."
"Thou shalt not desire their gods; for I will do unto them as they do unto their gods; take heed to thyself."

"Thou shalt not do so unto the Lord thy God; for every abomination to the Lord, which He hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods."
"I command thee this day to observe all these things; take heed to thyself, that thou add nothing to the word which I command thee, nor diminish ought from it."
"If there arises among you a prophet or a dreamer of dreams, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,
and it comes to pass, saying, 'Let us go after other gods, which you have not known, and let us serve them,'

you shall not listen to the words of that prophet or that dreamer of dreams; for the Lord your God is testing you to know whether you love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
You shall walk after the Lord your God and fear Him, and keep His commandments and obey His voice; you shall serve Him and hold fast to Him.
If you come out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and the Lord your God has brought you out, do not let that prophet or dreamer of dreams lead you astray; also, keep far from evil.

"If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, entices you secretly, saying, 'Let us go and serve other gods,' which you have not known,
from the gods of the peoples which are around you, near to you or far off from you, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth,
you shall not yield to him or listen to him; nor shall your eye pity him, nor shall you spare him or conceal him.
But you shall surely kill him; your hand shall be first against him to put him to death, and afterward the hand of all the people.
And you shall stone him with stones until he dies, because he sought to draw you away from the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage."
Let all Israel hear and fear; let not such wickedness arise again in your midst.
"The Lord your God has given you cities to dwell in, from among the cities of your inheritance."
The wicked shall depart from among you; if they go and worship other gods, saying, "Let us go and serve them," and you hear of it,
You shall seek Him, you shall inquire of Him; behold, if it be true, that this evil thing has been done in your midst,
Your land shall be smitten with the sword, and you shall be utterly destroyed; the nation, and all that is within it, you shall consume.
And all her goods shall be gathered to her; and the city, and all her goods, shall be burned with fire before the Lord your God; it shall be a desolation forever; do not do so.
The anger of the Lord shall return, and as He has spoken to your fathers, He shall remember you; He shall stir you up; He shall increase you; do not let anything that is strong be in your hand.
Today, if you keep all these commandments that I command you, and do what is good and right in the sight of the Lord your God, you shall be a son to Him.

sections.title: The way of the forsaken shall be forsaken.

verses.text: "Do not let the dead be a cause for your eyes to turn away from your face; do not forsake yourselves."
"For you are a holy people unto your God, the Lord; and He has chosen you to be a special people unto Himself above all the nations that are upon the earth."

sections.title: The creatures that are to be eaten and those that are not to be eaten.

verses.text: "Do not eat any abominable thing."
"These are the animals which ye may eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,"
"the deer, the gazelle, the roe, the wild goat, the pygarg, and the antelope."
"And every beast that parteth the hoof, and cleaveth the cleft into two claws, and cheweth the cud among the beasts, that shall ye eat."

"Nevertheless, these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, and the hare, and the coney; for they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof; therefore they are unclean unto you."
"And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean unto you: of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcass shall ye not touch."
"These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall ye eat."
"And whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye may not eat; it is unclean unto you."
"All clean birds ye shall eat."
"But these are they of which ye shall not eat: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray."
